It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Jun 10, 2025 to Jan 29 and a pullback of 0.92 of them to the Jul 17 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. against.head: Five waves up look complete
against.text: Five clean waves up from Oct 5 to Oct 30 (+24%), and the fifth wave's high came on weaker momentum than the third's (RSI 63 against 69 on Oct 19).
